candidates.statement: Payment service shows p95 latency of 1600ms versus 78ms on gateway, order, and inventory, with no db pool waiters or dependency timeouts. This isolated downstream latency at payment is the evidence-supported driver of checkout latency.
candidates.uncertainty: No traces or payment-internal breakdown; latency source within payment (CPU, GC, external call) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Only payment deviates: p95 1600ms and error_rate 0.004 versus 78ms/0.0014 elsewhere, with zero db_pool_waiters and dependency_timeouts. This bounds the candidate to downstream latency at payment; other taxonomy causes lack support.
